mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) despite a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the 20d horizon, or the decline reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting weakening labor market conditions and reduced consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5% in the trigger period, or the rate rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 20d despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising concurrently, or the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as higher interest rates reduce growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns (or 60d) despite FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% in the tightening cycle, or the rate rise is not sustained over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 2017=100 baseline signals strong supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding 100.0 over the 5d horizon, or the increase reverses before the period ends.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in monthly labor force participation (PAYEMS) above 1.5 million triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite PAYEMS crossing above 1.5 million in the trigger period, or the rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, indicating robust demand-driven economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 60d despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising concurrently, or the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, an increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 signals strong supply-side momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 20d despite INDPRO exceeding 105 in the late-cycle expansion regime.
